title: Don Hernando's Sunday
brief: You're Tomás. Don Hernando only turned up at the café on Sunday night, and this time you ask the questions: what he did all day, and when. Then tell him about your own Sunday. He's older than you, so use usted.

turns.npc: Buenos días, Tomás. Un tinto, por favor. El domingo no salí de mi casa hasta la noche.
turns.npcEn: Good morning, Tomás. A tinto, please. On Sunday I didn't leave my house until the evening.
turns.intent: Ask him what he did at home.

turns.npc: Llegó mi nieto de Cali. Comimos ajiaco y hablamos todo el día.
turns.npcEn: My grandson came from Cali. We ate ajiaco and talked all day.
turns.intent: Ask him what time his grandson arrived.
accept: ¿Y a qué hora llegó, don Hernando?

turns.npc: A las diez de la mañana. Y a las siete de la noche, ¡al café! ¿Y usted, qué hizo el domingo?
turns.npcEn: At ten in the morning. And at seven in the evening, off to the café! And you, what did you do on Sunday?
turns.intent: Say you went to the market with Doña Marta and carried five bags.
accept: Fui al mercado con doña Marta y llevé cinco bolsas.
Fui a la plaza de mercado con doña Marta. Llevé cinco bolsas.
Llevé cinco bolsas: fui al mercado con doña Marta.

turns.npc: ¿Con doña Marta? Ella compra barato. ¿A cómo está la papa?
turns.npcEn: With Doña Marta? She buys cheap. How much are potatoes going for?
turns.intent: Say they're two thousand pesos a kilo.
accept: Está a dos mil pesos el kilo.
La papa está a dos mil pesos el kilo.

turns.npcEn: Cheap! Well, Tomás. How much is the tinto?
turns.intent: Tell him he doesn't pay today: thank him for the taxi drivers.
accept: Hoy no paga, don Hernando. Gracias por los taxistas.
Gracias por los taxistas, don Hernando. Hoy no paga.
Hoy no. Gracias por los taxistas.
